summary: Re-tested POST /api/admin/assistant/email/send after E1's two fixes. Both critical bugs from iteration_4 are RESOLVED at the code level: (1) From is now POSTMARK_FROM (verified sender signature) with admin.email in Reply-To — the previous [400] 'not a Sender Signature' Postmark error is GONE. (2) Endpoint returns HTTP 400 (not 502) so Cloudflare passes the JSON body through unchanged — verified through the public URL. However, the same-domain 200 test still fails, but for a NEW external reason: Postmark's pending-approval mode considers 'mail.byrd-co.com' (POSTMARK_FROM's domain) DIFFERENT from 'byrd-co.com' (recipient) and returns [412]. This is a Postmark approval/config issue, not a code bug. 7 of 8 tests pass. All assistant regression endpoints pass.

minor.issue: Same-domain send to caleb@byrd-co.com still fails with HTTP 400 detail: '[412] While your account is pending approval, all recipient addresses must share the same domain as the From address. The domain of the From address is mail.byrd-co.com but you are attempting to send email to the following domain: byrd-co.com'. This is NOT a code bug — the fix (From=POSTMARK_FROM, Reply-To=admin.email) correctly landed. The blocker is external Postmark: POSTMARK_FROM=notifications@mail.byrd-co.com lives on subdomain mail.byrd-co.com, and Postmark's pending-approval rule treats mail.byrd-co.com != byrd-co.com. Two options for the user: (a) Get Postmark account approved out of trial in the dashboard, OR (b) Add a Sender Signature at an @byrd-co.com address (no subdomain) and change POSTMARK_FROM to it. No code change needed here — this is a Postmark account/config task.

action_items: USER ACTION (not code): resolve Postmark pending-approval OR verify an @byrd-co.com Sender Signature and update POSTMARK_FROM. Everything on the app side is now correct.

OPTIONAL: extend the 'pending approval' error-detail branch to also catch [412] response text (currently the detail says 'Raw error: [412]...') so the message is a little friendlier. Nice-to-have; the 400+JSON already reaches the frontend cleanly.

rca of the issue: Both critical bugs from iteration_4 are code-fixed and verified end-to-end through the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Fix #1 confirmed: swapping the [400] 'not a Sender Signature' error for the [412] 'pending approval' error proves the From address is now the verified POSTMARK_FROM. Fix #2 confirmed: the test client received a JSON body with content-type application/json and status 400, containing the full detail string with 'pending approval' and 'byrd-co.com' — Cloudflare no longer intercepts. Remaining friction: Postmark's pending-approval rule treats subdomains strictly, so sending FROM mail.byrd-co.com TO byrd-co.com counts as cross-domain. Resolution is external (Postmark dashboard) — either approve the account or add an @byrd-co.com Sender Signature. Reproduction of successful fix: curl -X POST $REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api/admin/assistant/email/send -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOK>' -d '{"to":"x@gmail.com","subject":"t","body":"t"}' now returns HTTP 400 with clean JSON, not Cloudflare's HTML 502 page.
